issues.on_page: Taxes (Nonmajor Funds column 784, p4; Lodging Tax Fund 784, p8)
issues.issue: The 784 lodging tax piece is supported under the relaxed fund-name rule: p8 shows the Lodging Tax Fund holds all of the Nonmajor Funds 784 of Taxes. The two pieces add to the printed 697,634 exactly. But the original_label 'Lodging Tax Fund Taxes' is made up. The page prints only 'Taxes', and the matching detail line uses 'Taxes'.

This single Road/Bridge disbursement line includes capital outlay 167,110 (p4 Road/Bridge column: Public Works 517,754 + Capital Outlay 167,110). Using the whole line as streets/highways is defensible because the schedule prints no breakdown.
The report has a $1 rounding difference between statements. It is mentioned in notes but not in report_discrepancies. The p5 lines do add to 701,459.
